extra.summary: The Citi PremierMiles Card excels for frequent travelers valuing miles that don't expire. Earn a decent 1.2 miles per S$1 locally and 2.2 miles overseas. Leverage Kaligo and Agoda for up to 10 miles per S$1. While there's an annual fee of $196.20 (waived the first year), the 10,000 renewal miles and two annual complimentary lounge visits help offset the cost. Use Citi PayAll to earn miles on large expenses such as rent.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Fee Waiver: First year annual fee waiver available
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: 1% plus 1% of any outstanding unbilled instalment amounts plus interest charges plus late payment charge or S$50, whichever is higher

our_takes.our-take: The Citi PremierMiles Card excels for frequent travelers valuing miles that don't expire. Earn a decent 1.2 miles per S$1 locally and 2.2 miles overseas. Leverage Kaligo and Agoda for up to 10 miles per S$1. While there's an annual fee of $196.20 (waived the first year), the 10,000 renewal miles and two annual complimentary lounge visits help offset the cost. Use Citi PayAll to earn miles on large expenses such as rent. Note the hefty 3.25% foreign transaction fee, impacting overseas spending value.
our_takes.good-for:
Jet-setters wanting to accumulate miles for flights and enjoy lounge access during layovers.
Individuals aiming to maximise miles on travel bookings, utility bills, and income tax payments.
Cardholders who need a flexible rewards program where miles don't expire, offering long-term value.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Annual fees apply after the first year; the $196.20 fee may outweigh benefits if spending is low.
Foreign transaction fees total 3.25%, plus 1% for currency conversion, increasing costs when spending overseas.
27.9% interest rate applies if balances are carried, quickly escalating debt if not paid in full.
